decisions.reason: As a more peripheral consumer product with weaker strategic fit than the firm's core waste-to-energy technologies, it is less likely to meet aspirations and more likely to be cut so resources can be redirected to higher-fit ventures.
Because it builds directly on the established industrial offer and the firm has growth, hiring and R&D slack, management would likely retain it unless clearer evidence of poor performance emerges.
Its strong fit with the firm's core mission and the relatively prominent, sustained website presentation suggest results are at least satisfactory enough to keep it on the market.

This product is close to the established offer and gained a dedicated page by 2019, so despite commercialization uncertainty management would likely continue it as a promising core-adjacent technology.
